name: skills-AI
title_zh: 给销售和市场团队的 B2B 打法技能库
tagline_zh: 写客户邮件、做竞品对比、排外呼节奏，每件技能都按 B2B 长决策链来设计，不是把 B2C 话术换个名字。
tagline_en: Cold emails, competitor battlecards, outbound cadences — each skill built for long B2B deal cycles, not rebranded.
desc_en: B2B AI skill library for sales, marketing, and GTM teams
why_zh: 按 GTM 角色分件，每件只干一段流程，输出直接能贴进 CRM 或序列工具，不用二次改写。
why_en: Organized by GTM role; each skill owns one step and outputs text you can paste straight into your CRM or sequencer.
limit_zh: 只覆盖销售、市场、GTM 三块，产品、法务、财务类需求一件都没有；技能给的是文案和框架，客户名单、CRM 数据。
limit_en: Covers only sales, marketing and GTM — no product, legal or finance skills. You supply the lead list, CRM data and sending channel.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: B2B playbook skills for sales and GTM teams
